        pat=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        ph,pw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for reg in zcomps(g):  # background 0 components (the empty frames)
        rs=[p[0] for p in reg];cs_=[p[1] for p in reg]
        r0=min(rs);r1=max(rs);c0=min(cs_);c1=max(cs_)
        bh=r1-r0+1;bw=c1-c0+1
        spats=[(i,j,g[r0+i][c0+j]) for i in range(bh) for j in range(bw) if g[r0+i][c0+j] not in (bg,0)]
        if not spats: continue
        Ph=max(i for i,_ in [(a,b) for a,b,_ in spats])+1
        Pw=max(j for _,b,_ in spats)+1
        for iy in range(r0,r1+1):
            for ix in range(c0,c1+1):
                k=((iy-r0)%Ph,(ix-c0)%Pw)
                vs=[v for a,b,v in spats if (a,b)==k]
                if vs: res[iy][ix]=vs[0]
    return res
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[];seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if g[y][x]!=bg and not seen[y][x]:
                st=[(y,x)];cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();cells.append((a,b))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(a+dy,b+dx)
                        if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg and n not in cells:
                            st.append(n)
                seeds.append(cells)
    zcs=comps_of(g,bg)
    holes=[zc for zc in zcs if not any(p[0]==0 or p[0]==H-1 or p[1]==0 or p[1]==W-1 for p in zc)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def bbox(sz):
        rs=[p[0] for p in sz];cs_=[p[1] for p in sz]
        return min(rs),min(cs_),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs_)-min(cs_)+1
    import heapq
    unassigned=[h for h in holes]
    while unassigned:
        hz=min(unassigned,key=len)
        best=None
        for s in seeds:
            b1=bbox(hz);b2=bbox(s)
            d=min(abs(b1[2]-b2[2])+abs(b1[3]-b2[3]), # rough
                  abs(min(r for r,c in hz)-min(r for r,c in s))+abs(min(c for r,c in hz)-min(c for r,c in s)))
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,s)
        if best is None: break
        d,s=best
        rs,sr0=best[1],None
        r0,c0,Ph,Pw=bbox(s)
        T=[[g[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(Pw)] for i in range(Ph)]
        mr=min(p[0] for p in hz);mc=min(p[1] for p in hz)
        for (yy,xx) in hz:
            out[yy][xx]=T[(yy-mr)%Ph][(xx-mc)%Pw]
        unassigned.remove(hz)
    return out

import numpy as np
def comps(g, bg):
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0]); lab=[[-1]*m for _ in range(n)]; out=[]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if lab[i][j]!=-1: continue
            st=[(i,j)]; cc=[]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                if lab[y][x]!=-1: continue
                lab[y][x]=1; cc.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<n and 0<=nx<m and lab[ny][nx]==-1 and g[ny][nx]==g[i][j]: st.append((ny,nx))
            out.append((cc,g[i][j]))
    return out

def solve(g):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for cc,col in comps(g,None):
        ys=[a for a,b in cc]; xs=[b for a,b in cc]
        if min(ys)==0 or max(ys)==H-1 or min(xs)==0 or max(xs)==W-1: continue
        # interior component of a non-background color => hole containing seed? treat colored comp as seed
        pass
    # rectangle = largest component of background color not touching border
    bgs=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(bgs,key=lambda c:bgs[c])
    for cc,col in comps(g,bg):
        ys=[a for a,b in cc]; xs=[b for a,b in cc]
        if not(0<min(ys) and max(ys)<H-1 and 0<min(xs) and max(xs)<W-1): continue
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,r0,r1,c0,c1,col)
    _,r0,r1,c0,c1,_=best
    # seed = non-bg components fully inside [r0..r1],[c0..c1]
    seeds=[cp for cp,c2 in comps(g,None) if all(r0<=y<=r1 and c0<=x<=c1 for y,x in cp)]
    sc=seeds[0]; sset=set(sc)
    sy0,sy1=min(y for y,_ in sc),max(y for y,_ in sc)
    sx0,sx1=min(x for _,x in sc),max(x for _,x in sc)
    hts=sy1-sy0+1; wts=sx1-sx0+1
    # drop leading zero columns of seed bbox
    cols=[x for x in range(sx0,sx1+1) if any((y,x) in sset for y in range(sy0,sy1+1))]
    tx0=cols[0]; tw=max(cols)-tx0+1
    tile=[[g[y][x] for x in range(tx0,tx0+tw)] for y in range(sy0,sy0+hts)]
    # fill rectangle with tile anchored at (r0,c0)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for y in range(r0,r1+1):
        for x in range(c0,c1+1):
            ty=(y-r0)%hts; tx=(x-c0)%tw
            res[y][x]=tile[ty][tx]
    return [[int(v) for v in row] for row in res]
